title: Show scoped order and receipt amount summaries in the visual report designer
description: A sales user selects the finite ERP amount-summary mode in the existing customer order and receipt designer and sees separate current-page order and unlinked-receipt amount panels. Consume the ERP amount-summary response without widening the current-user menu or salesperson scope; the server continues to recheck identity, permissions and bounded filters with existing HTTP audit. Escape labels, preserve original currencies, null unknowns, receipt evidence states and truncation; show empty, permission and network failures without stale data. Development only: no arbitrary SQL, direct database access, schema/migrations, production SQL or real database execution, writes, secrets/.env changes, deployment or real-browser acceptance. Verify Node tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Designer offers only server-supported none/customerCurrency amount modes and sends the selected mode with existing bounded, authorized preview filters.

Two separate current-page panels display order-side and unlinked-receipt evidence by customer, currency and receipt evidence status, with unknown totals, known/unknown counts, truncation and escaped labels; errors and empty results are explicit.
Node tests cover mode selection, multi-currency and null evidence, separated panels, safe labels, paging and permission/network failures; document the workflow and pass safe Release build/test.
